items.headline: Larry Page’s flying car company Pivotal loses its CEO
items.detail: The company told TechCrunch he is "pursuing new endeavors." Karklin will be replaced on an interim basis by Mike Ross, an aviation executive who joined Pivotal's board of directors in November 2025.

items.headline: Reliance’s JioHotstar takes its streaming empire global — without sports
items.detail: JioHotstar will only have entertainment content when it launches in the UK, Canada, and Singapore.

items.headline: Dell’s newest laptop sounds a lot like a MacBook Neo
items.detail: Dell's new Dell 14S laptop sounds a lot like a MacBook Neo: it comes in four colors, is aimed at students, and it starts with 8GB of RAM and 256GB of storage.

items.headline: This new Roomba seals itself to your carpet
items.detail: iRobot has announced a new flagship robot vacuum, which it will showcase at IFA in Berlin this week, the company's first big tech trade show in years.

items.headline: Palo Alto CEO says $1 trillion of cybersecurity infrastructure isn’t ready for AI
items.detail: Palo Alto CEO Nikesh Arora said AI is forcing companies to modernize roughly $1 trillion of aging cybersecurity infrastructure that isn’t equipped for attacks.

items.headline: Jim Cramer says Nvidia should do a half-trillion dollar, Apple-style stock buyback
items.detail: CNBC’s Jim Cramer said Nvidia should dramatically increase its stock buyback.
